phase: Pure Dimension Acquisition Cost Per Outcome
objective: Compose canonical acquisition economics buckets with canonical durable outcome buckets to project exact currency-isolated acquisition cost per quote and acquisition cost per bind for one acquisition dimension.
rules: The caller supplies one explicit relationship cohort, attributed economics views, durable outcome facts, and one canonical acquisition dimension.
Canonical economics aggregation remains sole owner of acquisition-cost grouping by dimension and currency.
Canonical durable dimension outcome analytics remains sole owner of quote and bind denominators.
Economics and outcome projections must report the same dimension and overall relationship count.
Corresponding buckets are joined only by canonical optional dimensionValue.
Corresponding economics and outcome buckets must report the same relationshipCount.
Every economics bucket must have exactly one corresponding outcome bucket and vice versa.
Currency totals remain isolated and are never converted or combined.
costPerQuote is exact numeratorMinorUnits equal to bucket currency acquisitionCostMinorUnits and denominatorCount equal to bucket quotedRelationshipCount.
costPerBind is exact numeratorMinorUnits equal to bucket currency acquisitionCostMinorUnits and denominatorCount equal to bucket boundRelationshipCount.
costPerQuote is omitted when quotedRelationshipCount is zero.
costPerBind is omitted when boundRelationshipCount is zero.
Zero acquisition cost with a positive outcome denominator remains an exact zero-over-denominator representation.
quoteStatus remains segmentation metadata only and never creates durable outcome evidence.
No arithmetic division, rounding, percentage formatting, SQL, persistence read, persistence mutation, or currency conversion is introduced.
